title: Great Staff
content: I suffer from white coat syndrome and consequently I hate the annual blood pressure checks. The HCA I saw today completely relaxed me and made me feel at ease with the procedure. Made the world of difference to me. Staff like this are worth their weight in gold.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
